newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Tung welcomes painted handover jumbo jet.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tung welcomes painted handover jumbo jet.

text.p: Hong Kong's future ruler Tung Chee-hwa on Thursday formally welcomed a jumbo jet specially painted to commemorate the British colony's handover to China.
The Cathay Pacific 747 is covered with brushstroke depictions of Hong Kong's dramatic backdrop of skyscrapers beside the Chinese character "Ga" which means "Home."

"We feel that having one of our aircraft designed in a unique livery is a great way for Cathay Pacific to spread the good news about Hong Kong's future," said the airline's deputy chairman Patrick Tsai.
Lion-dancers then cavorted around the plane and Tung ceremonially dotted their eyes to wish them luck.
